newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges higher, techs rebound.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges higher, techs rebound.

text.p: U.S. blue chips surged sharply higher Tuesday, gaining over 80 points in the late morning.
The Dow industrials rose about 86 points to 7565, yet another record high after two days of new heights.

The Nasdaq Composite rebounded from minor losses into positive territory, gaining about 2.41 to 1414. The index was hurt by weakness in certain technology stocks, such as Xylan Corp and Ascend Communications Inc.
The long bond was higher, up 8/32 to yield 6.80 percent.
